title: Hitler's World War I poems to Odin and Thor

tellings.quote: >> and wasn't Hitler writing poetry to the Nordic gods and as a soldier in World War I? >> Yes, he was. He wrote it. They're reprinted in I think it's Tolen's biography of Hitler.

plain: While serving as a soldier in the First World War, Adolf Hitler is said to have written poems to the old Norse gods Odin and Thor. An author named Peter Levenda, billed on the show as a CIA historian, agrees when Michels asks about it, and says the poems are reprinted in what he thinks is the historian John Toland's biography of Hitler. He tells it as a sign of Hitler's early pull toward pagan and occult ideas.
